design.seed_role: paired with preceding immutable three-release cohorts, not a fresh confirmation
design.accountant: same distributed discrete Gaussian; rounds=1; exact integer recalibration
design.additional_regions: preceding public-configured K/estimator; Web K=12/M; FEMNIST K=124/M
design.coverage: K>=C; maximize weighted projected scores subject to at least one region per class
design.no_label_primary_decoder: center; coverage retained as a separate fixed postprocessing rule
design.label_pool: development only; all its feature vectors are public to every arm
public_baselines: ridge linear head with exact leave-one-out selection
label spreading, ordinary and class-mass-normalized, leave-one-out selection

public_graph.nodes: development plus proxy; test is inductive query only
public_graph.affinity: symmetric Gaussian kNN; bandwidth median squared twentieth-neighbor distance

design.public_portfolio_selection: leave-one-out accuracy, balanced accuracy on Web; fixed candidate-order tie break
design.missing_region_fallback: nearest nonempty named public region; ties lowest region/class index
design.private_frontier: T1, 180 private steps, fixed K=C/M; no public teacher or public validation dataset

hybrid.public_component: public portfolio chosen using labels within m
candidates: score mixture with private hard regional labels
hybrid.selection: leave-one-out on the same m labels; no test or clean private counts

design.uncertainty: fully crossed label draws and paired cohort/noise seeds; two-way bootstrap, 2000 replicates

safety.publication_gate: LOO hybrid gain lower bound over selected public portfolio >0, plus all-class coverage
safety.min_recall: LOO Wilson 95% lower bound >0 for every class; unobserved class fails
safety.local_models: remain private; public proxy does not certify private local benefit

design.bound_diagnostic: unprojected sup shift; first-release centered/matching bound; raw has separate gap bound
